title: Upgrade Deck ({xp} TOTAL xp)
killed: Your investigator was killed or driven insane. Pick a new investigator.
directlyUpdateContent: Upgrade your deck directly in {deckSource} and sync here.
waitingOtherPlayer: Waiting for other players to upgrade deck.
fetchFailed: Could not fetch the deck from {deckSource}. Check that the deck is public and try again.
fetchUnusable: The deck fetched from {deckSource} has no investigator or no cards, so it cannot be used.
arkhamBuildShareNotFound: arkham.build has no shared deck at that link. Open the deck on arkham.build and use its Share link — the address bar link to your own deck will not work.
unrecognizedUrl: That does not look like an ArkhamDB or arkham.build deck url.
uploadInvalidJson: That file is not valid JSON. Export the deck from ArkhamDB or arkham.build and upload that file.
uploadNotADecklist: That file does not look like a deck export — it has no investigator or no cards.
noChangesPrompt: This deck adds no new cards and you still have {xp} unspent XP. On arkham.build and ArkhamDB the upgraded version is created BEFORE you spend XP — finish your changes there, then pull again. Upgrade with no changes anyway?
upgradeFailed: Could not upgrade the deck. Nothing was changed, so you can safely try again.
skippingPrompt: Are you sure you want to skip upgrading this deck?
